provenance: SPADL (Soccer Player Action Description Language, socceraction 1.5.3) actions converted by ETL from the provider's Opta-style MA3 events (etl/contracts, Output 3). Synthetic match data, not a licensed feed.

fields.action_id: Order of the action in the match: 0, 1, 2, ... Stable; an action is stored only once final.
fields.period: Football period: 1 first half, 2 second half, 3/4 extra-time halves, 5 shootout. Stoppage time stays in its period.
fields.match_time_seconds: Broadcast clock in whole seconds (timeMin*60 + timeSec). The second half starts at 2700; first-half stoppage keeps period 1 above 2700, so order by period then clock.
fields.player_id: Player performing the action: the passer, shooter, tackler, goalkeeper. Never the receiver or opponent.
fields.result: SPADL result of the action (see results).
fields.bodypart: Body part used (see bodyparts). Defaults to foot (other for keeper actions) when the provider named none.
fields.bodypart_observed: True when a provider qualifier named the body part; false when the SPADL default applies.
fields.start_x: Start location along the pitch in metres, 0-105, team-relative: the acting team attacks towards x = 105.
fields.start_y: Start location across the pitch in metres, 0-68, team-relative: y = 0 is the acting team's right touchline.
fields.end_x: End location along the pitch (metres, team-relative). A shot ends at the goal line (105) or where it was blocked.
fields.end_y: End location across the pitch (metres, team-relative).
fields.start_zone: Team-relative zone of the start location (see zones).
fields.end_zone: Team-relative zone of the end location (see zones).
fields.seq: Canonical seq of the source event.
fields.final_seq: Canonical seq after which the action cannot change; a snapshot reads actions with final_seq <= its seq.
fields.source_event_id: Provider event the action came from; null for inserted dribbles.
fields.source_type_id: Opta type of the source event (e.g. 15 attempt saved, 16 goal); null for inserted dribbles.
fields.video_seconds: Match video time of the source event; not the football clock.
fields.possession_id: Provider possession sequence; increases when the other team gains the ball or a restart is taken.
fields.from_shot_off_target: keeper_save only: the keeper touched a shot that was going wide (Opta qualifier 190), not a save.
fields.defensive_block: keeper_save only: an outfield player blocked the shot (Opta qualifier 94), not a goalkeeper save.

derived.distance_metres: Ball travel from start to end location in metres (sum/average field).
derived.shot_outcome: Shot types only: goal (result success), saved (Opta 15 ending on the goal line: on target, not scored), blocked (Opta 15 stopped before the goal line), post (Opta 14), off_target (Opta 13). On target = goal + saved.
derived.save_kind: keeper_save only: save (a real goalkeeper save; the shots_saved stat), wide_touch (from_shot_off_target), block (defensive_block).

events.cross: Cross into the box in open play.
events.freekick_crossed: Free kick crossed into the box.
events.take_on: Attempt to dribble past an opponent; success when the player gets past.
events.foul: Foul committed by the acting player (always result fail). The team fouled is the opponent.
events.tackle: Tackle on the ball; success when the tackler's team wins the ball or play stops.
events.interception: Interception of a pass, including a blocked pass; success when the intercepting team keeps the ball.
events.shot: Shot attempt in open play; success = goal. Own goals are bad_touch with result owngoal, not shots.
events.keeper_save: Every provider save event, including outfield blocks and keeper touches of shots going wide; save_kind save is a real goalkeeper save.
events.keeper_claim: Goalkeeper catches a cross or high ball.
events.clearance: Defensive clearance; it ends where the next action starts.
events.bad_touch: Accidental touch that loses the ball, or an own goal (result owngoal).
events.dribble: Carry: the ball moved by the same team between two of its actions (3-60 m, under 10 s), inserted by the converter.

results.fail: Unsuccessful: pass or cross not reaching a team-mate, missed or saved shot, lost duel, every foul.
results.success: Successful: completed pass, goal, won tackle or take-on, keeper action that kept the ball.
results.offside: A pass caught offside (credited to the passer's team).
results.owngoal: An own goal (on a bad_touch), credited to the team that put it in its own net.
results.yellow_card: Not produced from this feed: cards are outside SPADL.
results.red_card: Not produced from this feed: cards are outside SPADL.

bodyparts.foot: Foot, side unknown (also the default when the provider named no body part).
bodyparts.head: Header.
bodyparts.other: Other body part, hands or throw-ins; the default for keeper actions.

zones.own_box: The acting team's own penalty area.
zones.defensive_third: The acting team's own third (0-35 m), outside its own box.
zones.final_third: The attacking third (70-105 m), outside the opponent's box. Final-third entries count final_third and opp_box.
zones.opp_box: The opponent's penalty area (16.5 m deep, 40.32 m wide).

families.passes: Pass family: pass, cross, throw_in, freekick_crossed, freekick_short, corner_crossed, corner_short, goalkick. 'Passes' means the whole family, as the catalogue counts.
families.shots: Shot family: shot, shot_penalty, shot_freekick. Goals = shot family with result success plus the opponent's owngoal.

outside_spadl: Cards (yellow, second yellow, red) are provider card events: use the cards catalogue stat; the backend names sent-off players.
Possession is a share of measured ball-ownership time: use the possession catalogue stat; never count actions for it.
Penalties awarded, VAR decisions and substitutions are not actions.
guarantees: Each action is final once served and never revised.
One action per on-the-ball event: a shot and its save are two actions by opposite teams; counting both double-counts the incident.
Whole-match scope has no period restriction. Clock bounds do not imply a half; half selection includes its stoppage time.
Player and team restrictions are separate. A player's club is not an implicit team filter.

Custom calculations filter action_type, result, bodypart, start_zone, end_zone, shot_outcome, save_kind, team_id, player_id, period, match_time_seconds and start/end x/y ranges, and sum only distance_metres.
unavailable: Player running distance, speed, xG, expected threat, pressures, aerial duels, ball recoveries, kick-offs, substitutions, injuries. (Touches: count a player's actions of every type except dribble, as on-ball actions.)
Sequences (an action followed by another), possession-chain filters and score-dependent conditions in custom calculations.
